notes.scope: Every item that wowsims/forever registers an equip proc, chance-on-hit, struck proc or on-use for: generated registrations in sim/common/forever/stat_bonus_procs_auto_gen.go and stat_bonus_cds_auto_gen.go, hand-written ones in sim/common/forever/items_*.go, sim/common/classic/items_weapons.go and sim/<class>/item*.go. Enchants, consumables and set bonuses are left out. Plain equip auras (class-spell modifiers, versus-creature bonuses, damage shields) are included with trigger "equip".
notes.resolution: Numbers come from the spell store sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (base points + per-level gain at level 60, Variance spread for min/max) and assets/database/db.json itemEffects (stat amounts in scalingOptions, proc ppm/procChance/icdMs, onUse cooldownMs). Rates come from the generator comment "trigger X (rate, callback, mask)" above each generated registration, else the trigger row (ProcChance / RPPM / ICDMs). Items marked "checked" were hand-reviewed against their code; items with "derived" are automatic and the code may add conditions.
notes.stats: stat names follow proto/common.proto (Strength, AttackPower, SpellDamage, FireDamage, ArmorNoMods, PhysicalDamage, NatureResistance, ...). kind "statpct" carries percentage pseudo stats that are not proto Stats: PhysicalHitPercent, SpellHitPercent, PhysicalCritPercent, SpellCritPercent, MeleeHastePercent, RangedHastePercent, CastSpeedPercent, DodgePercent, ParryPercent, BlockPercent, HealthPercent, DamageDealtPercent, DamageTakenPercent, ThreatPercent, <Stat>Percent, ArmorFromItemsPercent, BonusArmorPercent, BlockValuePercent, SpiritRegenWhileCastingPercent, CritPercentVsTarget.
notes.triggers: melee, ranged, spell, heal, any, use as asked, plus: equip (passive while worn), struck (when you are hit), melee+ranged, spell+heal, combatstart, kill, unknown. ppm = procs per minute (weapon speed normalised), chance = 0..1 per qualifying event, icd/cooldown/duration in seconds.
notes.kinds: stat, statpct, damage (periodic: true for DoTs with perTick/period/ticks and min/max = total), heal, absorb, energize (resource Mana/Rage/Energy), extraattack, weapondamage, spellmod (class spell modifier, unresolved), other (non-stat effect), unknown. onTarget: true = debuff on the target. versus = only against those creature types. countdown = starts full and loses a stack per event; stacking = grows per event.
notes.notSimulated: notSimulated lists items whose generated registration is commented out as a TODO (wowsims does not model them), with the tooltip text where the generator gave one.
notes.skipped: Not included: the TBC PvP medallions (28234-28243, 30343-30351, 37864, 37865) registered in items_pvp_trinkets.go are not in the Forever item db; hunter PvP gloves at sim/hunter/item_sets.go:199 register an empty effect.
